text.content: Plan CWAM-COSMOS3-B5-VOM-PROBE-R4-20260817 starts from the completed R3 probe. Restore and strengthen local token-to-slot competition and diversity, add adjacent-frame cross-object and cross-episode negatives, and supervise memory attention with detached first-order slot gradients from the main action loss. Keep the matched 8-B200, 500-step B4-warm probe and identical 2048-sample none/zero/shuffle interventions. Gates: finite tests and BF16 smoke, complete checkpoint, final slot absolute cosine below 0.95, positive-to-negative similarity margins above 0.05, active finite action-gradient alignment, and at least 1% aligned main-action improvement over both zero and shuffle. Do not launch 20k unless every gate passes.
